scope: machine-style-scan; not independent full read or prediction validation

method.quoteExclusion: remove explicit 「」 『』 “” 《》 〈〉 contents before literal text, sentence, clause and ngram matching
method.monthStart: first Han character of displayed text equals row month branch; completeMonthStartLines require all 12 articles in one line to meet this condition; lexical false positives are also reported separately with a conservative semantic filter; does not imply wrong rule
method.firstPrefix: first normalized Han sentence, 12/16/24 Han; month-normalized variant substitutes the actual branch only if initial; crossPunctuation variants use all first paragraph (body) or short without sentence boundary, excluding quoted text and punctuation
method.longSentence: exact normalized unquoted sequences of at least 24 Han between 。！？ newline
method.longClause: exact normalized unquoted sequences of at least 16 Han between sentence, comma/colon/semicolon markers
method.nearDuplicate: exact Jaccard of unique normalized unquoted Han 3-grams, length/rare-prefix pruning; all pairs meeting threshold retrieved
method.humanMeaning: same qi judgments and source-based necessary terminology may repeat legitimately; groups are review candidates, not automatic faults
